_note: Discriminator id list for Bedside Brief. Owner-editable until freeze #1. Sorted by priority, then first presentation in cardiology-first order. See DECISIONS.md #3/#4.

ids.title: Abdominojugular (hepatojugular) reflux: sustained JVP rise >3 cm with 10-30 s abdominal pressure
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2005 'Does this dyspneic patient in the emergency department have congestive heart failure?' Wang CS et al; PMID 16234501 ; also JAMA RCE 1996 'Does this patient have abnormal central venous pressure?' Cook DJ, Simel DL; PMID 8594245

ids.title: Ascending symmetric limb weakness with absent/reduced reflexes (after recent GI/URI illness)
ids.anchor_source: Fokke C et al 2014 'Diagnosis of Guillain-Barre syndrome and validation of Brighton criteria' Brain; PMID 24163275; Brighton Collaboration case definition (consensus)

ids.title: Unilaterally absent or markedly reduced breath sounds (+/- tracheal deviation as late tension sign)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2009 'Does this patient have a pleural effusion?' Wong CL, Holroyd-Leduc J, Straus SE; PMID 19155458 ; pneumonia: JAMA RCE 1997 'Does this patient have community-acquired pneumonia?' Metlay JP, Kapoor WN, Fine MJ; PMID 9356004

ids.title: Unilateral leg swelling: calf circumference difference >3 cm (10 cm below tibial tuberosity), with calf tenderness
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2006 'Does this patient have deep vein thrombosis?' Wells PS, Owen C, Doucette S, Fergusson D, Tran H; PMID 16403932 ; also JAMA RCE 1998 'Does this patient have deep vein thrombosis?' Anand SS et al; PMID 9546569

ids.title: Capillary refill time prolonged (>2-3 s, fingertip at heart level, warm room)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1999 'Is this patient hypovolemic?' McGee S, Abernethy WB, Simel DL; PMID 10086438 (CRT not useful for hypovolemia); prognostic in septic shock: Ait-Oufella H et al, Intensive Care Med 2014 PMID 24811942; meta-analysis Jacquet-Lagreze M et al, Crit Care 2023 PMID 38042855

ids.title: Delayed and diminished carotid upstroke (pulsus parvus et tardus)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1997 'Does this patient have an abnormal systolic murmur?' Etchells E et al; PMID 9032164

ids.title: Egophony (E-to-A change) or bronchial breath sounds over a focal area
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1997 'Does this patient have community-acquired pneumonia?' Metlay JP, Kapoor WN, Fine MJ; PMID 9356004 ; also Acad Emerg Med 2020 'Accuracy of signs and symptoms for the diagnosis of community-acquired pneumonia: a meta-analysis' Ebell MH et al; PMID 32329557

ids.title: Fatigable ptosis on sustained upgaze (60 s)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2005 'Does this patient have myasthenia gravis?' Scherer K, Bedlack RS, Simel DL; PMID 15840866

ids.title: Jugular venous pressure elevated (>8 cm H2O / >3 cm above sternal angle); low/flat JVP as the negative
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1996 'Does this patient have abnormal central venous pressure?' Cook DJ, Simel DL; PMID 8594245 ; also JAMA RCE 2005 'Does this dyspneic patient in the emergency department have congestive heart failure?' Wang CS et al; PMID 16234501

ids.title: Harsh crescendo-decrescendo systolic murmur, late-peaking, radiating to carotids, with soft/absent A2
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1997 'Does this patient have an abnormal systolic murmur?' Etchells E et al; PMID 9032164

ids.title: Dullness to percussion with decreased tactile fremitus (focal; conventional vs auscultatory percussion)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2009 'Does this patient have a pleural effusion?' Wong CL, Holroyd-Leduc J, Straus SE; PMID 19155458 ; pneumonia: JAMA RCE 1997 'Does this patient have community-acquired pneumonia?' Metlay JP, Kapoor WN, Fine MJ; PMID 9356004

ids.title: Lower-extremity edema: bilateral vs unilateral, pitting vs non-pitting (brawny), grade and level
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2005 'Does this dyspneic patient in the emergency department have congestive heart failure?' Wang CS et al; PMID 16234501

ids.title: Pulmonary crackles: bibasilar (heart failure) vs focal/unilateral (pneumonia)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2005 'Does this dyspneic patient in the emergency department have congestive heart failure?' Wang CS et al; PMID 16234501 ; pneumonia: JAMA RCE 1997 'Does this patient have community-acquired pneumonia?' Metlay JP, Kapoor WN, Fine MJ; PMID 9356004 || JAMA RCE 1997 'Does this patient have community-acquired pneumonia? Diagnosing pneumonia by history and physical examination' Metlay JP, Kapoor WN, Fine MJ; PMID 9356004

ids.title: Radial pulse irregularly irregular on palpation (>=20-30 s)
ids.anchor_source: J Fam Pract 2006 'Is pulse palpation helpful in detecting atrial fibrillation? A systematic review' Cooke G, Doust J, Sanders S; PMID 16451780

ids.title: Pulsus paradoxus >10-12 mmHg (inspiratory SBP fall by manual cuff)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2007 'Does this patient with a pericardial effusion have cardiac tamponade?' Roy CL et al; PMID 17456823 ; asthma context: JAMA RCE 1995 'Does the clinical examination predict airflow limitation?' Holleman DR, Simel DL; PMID 7815660

ids.title: Third heart sound (S3 gallop) at apex with bell, left lateral decubitus
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2005 'Does this dyspneic patient in the emergency department have congestive heart failure?' Wang CS et al; PMID 16234501 ; also JAMA RCE 1997 'Can the clinical examination diagnose left-sided heart failure in adults?' Badgett RG et al; PMID 9169900

ids.title: Respiratory rate >24-25/min counted for 60 s
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1997 'Does this patient have community-acquired pneumonia?' Metlay JP, Kapoor WN, Fine MJ; PMID 9356004 ; PE context: JAMA RCE 2003 'Does this patient have pulmonary embolism?' Chunilal SD et al; PMID 14657070

ids.title: Wheezing on auscultation (diffuse expiratory vs focal/monophonic)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1995 'Does the clinical examination predict airflow limitation?' Holleman DR, Simel DL; PMID 7815660 ; also JAMA RCE 2000 'The accuracy of patient history, wheezing, and laryngeal measurements in diagnosing obstructive airway disease' (CARE-COAD1) Straus SE et al; PMID 10770147

ids.title: Dynamic auscultation: systolic murmur louder with Valsalva/standing, softer with squatting or handgrip
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1997 'Does this patient have an abnormal systolic murmur?' Etchells E et al; PMID 9032164 ; primary: NEJM 1988 'Bedside diagnosis of systolic murmurs' Lembo NJ et al; PMID 2897627

ids.title: Passive leg raise: hemodynamic response (BP/pulse pressure or POCUS VTI rise >=10-12%) within 60-90 s of raising legs 45 deg from semi-recumbent
ids.anchor_source: Monnet X et al, Intensive Care Med 2016 'Passive leg raising for predicting fluid responsiveness: a systematic review and meta-analysis'; PMID 26825952. Pitfall: pulse-pressure/BP-based PLR is much less accurate than CO-based.

ids.title: Single breath count (count aloud on one full inspiration; <20 signals weak respiratory muscles)
ids.anchor_source: 'Single breath count test and its applications in clinical practice: a systematic review' Ann Med Surg (Lond) 2024; PMID 38576972 (correlation with FVC in neuromuscular disease)

ids.title: Chest pain provoked by exertion, relieved by rest (typical angina pattern)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA 2005 'Value and limitations of chest pain history in the evaluation of patients with suspected acute coronary syndromes' Swap CJ, Nagurney JT; PMID 16304077 ; also JAMA RCE 2015 'Does this patient with chest pain have acute coronary syndrome?' Fanaroff AC et al; PMID 26547467

ids.title: Orthopnea: dyspnea lying flat relieved by sitting up / number of pillows
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2005 'Does this dyspneic patient in the emergency department have congestive heart failure?' Wang CS et al; PMID 16234501

ids.title: Chest pain radiating to both arms (or right arm/shoulder), with diaphoresis
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2015 'Does this patient with chest pain have acute coronary syndrome?' Fanaroff AC et al; PMID 26547467 ; also JAMA 2005 'Value and limitations of chest pain history in the evaluation of patients with suspected acute coronary syndromes' Swap CJ, Nagurney JT; PMID 16304077 ; JAMA RCE 1998 'Is this patient having a myocardial infarction?' Panju AA et al; PMID 9786377

ids.title: Pleuritic chest pain (sharp, worse with inspiration/cough), +/- hemoptysis
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2003 'Does this patient have pulmonary embolism?' Chunilal SD et al; PMID 14657070 ; MI negative: JAMA 2005 'Value and limitations of chest pain history in the evaluation of patients with suspected acute coronary syndromes' Swap CJ, Nagurney JT; PMID 16304077 ; JAMA RCE 1998 'Is this patient having a myocardial infarction?' Panju AA et al; PMID 9786377

ids.title: Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea: waking 1-3 h after sleep with dyspnea relieved by sitting/standing
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2005 'Does this dyspneic patient in the emergency department have congestive heart failure?' Wang CS et al; PMID 16234501

ids.title: VTE risk history (Wells items): immobilization >=3 days or surgery within 4-12 weeks, prior objectively confirmed VTE, active malignancy
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2003 'Does this patient have pulmonary embolism?' Chunilal SD et al; PMID 14657070 ; DVT: JAMA RCE 2006 'Does this patient have deep vein thrombosis?' Wells PS, Owen C, Doucette S, Fergusson D, Tran H; PMID 16403932

ids.title: POCUS 2-point/3-point compression ultrasound of femoral and popliteal veins
ids.anchor_source: Pomero F et al 2013 'Accuracy of emergency physician-performed ultrasonography in the diagnosis of deep-vein thrombosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis' Thromb Haemost; PMID 23138420; index: JAMA RCE 2006 Wells PS PMID 16403932

ids.title: POCUS IVC: diameter and respiratory collapsibility (subxiphoid long axis, 2-3 cm from RA junction)
ids.anchor_source: Shock 2017 'Does respiratory variation in inferior vena cava diameter predict fluid responsiveness: a systematic review and meta-analysis' Long E et al; PMID 28410544 (also Orso D et al, J Intensive Care Med 2020; PMID 29343170)

ids.title: POCUS lung: >=3 B-lines per intercostal space in >=2 bilateral zones (interstitial syndrome)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA Netw Open 2019 'Diagnostic accuracy of point-of-care lung ultrasonography and chest radiography in adults with symptoms suggestive of acute decompensated heart failure' Maw AM et al; PMID 30874784 ; protocol: Chest 2008 'Relevance of lung ultrasound in the diagnosis of acute respiratory failure: the BLUE protocol' Lichtenstein DA, Meziere GA; PMID 18403664

ids.title: POCUS lung: absent lung sliding (+/- lung point, absent B-lines) for pneumothorax
ids.anchor_source: Chest 2012 'Test characteristics of ultrasonography for the detection of pneumothorax: a systematic review and meta-analysis' Alrajhi K, Woo MY, Vaillancourt C; PMID 21868468

ids.title: POCUS cardiac: qualitative LV systolic function (normal / reduced / severely reduced; EPSS as adjunct) in PLAX/A4C
ids.anchor_source: Acad Emerg Med 2002 'Determination of left ventricular function by emergency physician echocardiography of hypotensive patients' Moore CL et al; PMID 11874773

ids.title: POCUS cardiac: pericardial effusion (subxiphoid/PLAX), with RA/RV diastolic collapse for tamponade
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2007 'Does this patient with a pericardial effusion have cardiac tamponade?' Roy CL et al; PMID 17456823 (clinical context; echo is the reference standard). POCUS accuracy primary: Mandavia DP et al, Ann Emerg Med 2001 'Bedside echocardiography by emergency physicians' (PMID not confirmed)

ids.title: POCUS cardiac: RV dilation (RV:LV >1), septal flattening, McConnell sign
ids.anchor_source: J Am Soc Echocardiogr 2017 'Transthoracic echocardiography for diagnosing pulmonary embolism: a systematic review and meta-analysis' Fields JM et al; PMID 28495379

ids.title: Inter-arm systolic BP difference >20 mmHg
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2002 'Does this patient have an acute thoracic aortic dissection?' Klompas M; PMID 11980527 ; also Acad Emerg Med 2018 'Clinical examination for acute aortic dissection: a systematic review and meta-analysis' Ohle R et al; PMID 29265487

ids.title: Chest pain fully reproduced by palpation of chest wall
ids.anchor_source: JAMA 2005 'Value and limitations of chest pain history in the evaluation of patients with suspected acute coronary syndromes' Swap CJ, Nagurney JT; PMID 16304077 ; also JAMA RCE 2015 'Does this patient with chest pain have acute coronary syndrome?' Fanaroff AC et al; PMID 26547467 ; JAMA RCE 1998 'Is this patient having a myocardial infarction?' Panju AA et al; PMID 9786377

ids.title: Pulse deficit / asymmetric radial, carotid or femoral pulses
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2002 'Does this patient have an acute thoracic aortic dissection?' Klompas M; PMID 11980527 ; also Acad Emerg Med 2018 'Clinical examination for acute aortic dissection: a systematic review and meta-analysis' Ohle R et al; PMID 29265487

ids.title: Pain abrupt in onset and maximal at onset (thunderclap-type chest/back pain)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2002 'Does this patient have an acute thoracic aortic dissection?' Klompas M; PMID 11980527 ; also Acad Emerg Med 2018 'Clinical examination for acute aortic dissection: a systematic review and meta-analysis' Ohle R et al; PMID 29265487

ids.title: Pain described as tearing or ripping, or migrating (chest to back/abdomen/legs)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2002 'Does this patient have an acute thoracic aortic dissection?' Klompas M; PMID 11980527 ; also Acad Emerg Med 2018 'Clinical examination for acute aortic dissection: a systematic review and meta-analysis' Ohle R et al; PMID 29265487

ids.title: Melena on digital rectal exam, or reported black tarry stool / hematemesis
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2012 'Does this patient have a severe upper gastrointestinal bleed?' Srygley FD, Gerardo CJ, Tran T, Fisher DA; PMID 22416103 (melena on exam LR+ ~25); NSAID-use history: JAMA RCE 2006 dyspepsia Moayyedi P et al PMID 16595759 || JAMA RCE 2012 'Does this patient have a severe upper gastrointestinal bleed?' Srygley FD et al; PMID 22416103

ids.title: Orthostatic vitals: SBP drop >=20 / DBP >=10 mmHg or pulse increment >=30/min at 1-3 min standing
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1999 'Is this patient hypovolemic?' McGee S, Abernethy WB, Simel DL; PMID 10086438 ; also JAMA RCE 2019 'Did this patient have cardiac syncope?' Albassam OT et al; PMID 31237649

ids.title: Palpable pulsatile abdominal mass (widened aortic pulsation)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1999 'Does this patient have abdominal aortic aneurysm?' Lederle FA, Simel DL; PMID 9892455 (sensitivity falls with abdominal girth and small AAA)

ids.title: Patient taps out the palpitation rhythm: regular vs irregular; rapid regular vs 'skipped beats'
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2009 'Does this patient with palpitations have a cardiac arrhythmia?' Thavendiranathan P et al; PMID 19920238

ids.title: Timing and triggers (TiTrATE: episodic vs continuous, triggered vs spontaneous) rather than symptom quality; associated diplopia/dysarthria/dysphagia/hearing loss
ids.anchor_source: Newman-Toker DE, Edlow JA, Neurol Clin 2015 'TiTrATE' PMID 26231273; Newman-Toker DE et al, Mayo Clin Proc 2007 'Imprecision in patient reports of dizziness symptom quality' PMID 17976352

ids.title: Syncope during (not after) exertion
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2019 'Did this patient have cardiac syncope?' Albassam OT et al; PMID 31237649

ids.title: Regular rapid pounding in the neck / visible neck pulsations during episodes (frog sign)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2009 'Does this patient with palpitations have a cardiac arrhythmia?' Thavendiranathan P et al; PMID 19920238 ; mechanism: NEJM 1992 'The hemodynamic mechanism of pounding in the neck in atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia' Gursoy S et al; PMID 1501653

ids.title: Abrupt onset and abrupt termination of palpitations (vs gradual)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2009 'Does this patient with palpitations have a cardiac arrhythmia?' Thavendiranathan P et al; PMID 19920238

ids.title: Palpitations immediately preceding syncope
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2019 'Did this patient have cardiac syncope?' Albassam OT et al; PMID 31237649 ; also JAMA RCE 2009 'Does this patient with palpitations have a cardiac arrhythmia?' Thavendiranathan P et al; PMID 19920238

ids.title: Seizure-vs-syncope features: prolonged (>1-5 min) post-event confusion, lateral tongue biting, head turning, incontinence
ids.anchor_source: JACC 2002 'Historical criteria that distinguish syncope from seizures' Sheldon R et al; PMID 12103268

ids.title: Severe postural dizziness / inability to stand for vitals
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1999 'Is this patient hypovolemic?' McGee S, Abernethy WB, Simel DL; PMID 10086438; primary: Witting MD et al, Ann Emerg Med 1994 'Defining the positive tilt test' PMID 8198307

ids.title: Prodrome before loss of consciousness (nausea, warmth, diaphoresis, visual graying) and situational trigger (micturition, cough, prolonged standing, pain, post-prandial) vs none
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2019 'Did this patient have cardiac syncope?' Albassam OT et al; PMID 31237649 ; also Eur Heart J 2006 'Diagnostic criteria for vasovagal syncope based on a quantitative history' (Calgary Syncope Symptom Score) Sheldon R et al; PMID 16223744

ids.title: Syncope while supine or seated without warning
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2019 'Did this patient have cardiac syncope?' Albassam OT et al; PMID 31237649 ; also Eur Heart J 2006 'Diagnostic criteria for vasovagal syncope based on a quantitative history' (Calgary Syncope Symptom Score) Sheldon R et al; PMID 16223744

ids.title: POCUS abdominal aorta diameter (>3 cm)
ids.anchor_source: Rubano E, Mehta N, Caputo W, Paladino L, Sinert R 2013 'Systematic review: emergency department bedside ultrasonography for diagnosing suspected abdominal aortic aneurysm' Acad Emerg Med; PMID 23406071; index: JAMA RCE 1999 Lederle FA PMID 9892455 || Rubano E et al, Acad Emerg Med 2013 'Systematic review: ED bedside ultrasonography for diagnosing suspected abdominal aortic aneurysm'; PMID 23406071

ids.title: Alcohol use (CAGE) and time since last drink; tremor, diaphoresis, agitation (CIWA items)

ids.title: Ascites exam: flank dullness, shifting dullness, fluid wave

ids.title: Unilateral warm erythema with defined border (vs bilateral / stasis change)

ids.title: Cirrhosis stigmata: spider angiomata, palmar erythema, gynecomastia, caput medusae, jaundice
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2012 'Does this patient with liver disease have cirrhosis?' Udell JA et al; PMID 22357834

ids.title: Ascites signs: shifting dullness, flank dullness, fluid wave, bulging flanks

ids.title: Involuntary guarding / board-like rigidity

ids.title: Dry axilla

ids.title: Dry oral mucous membranes, tongue furrows, sunken eyes, dry axilla

ids.title: Skin mottling score (knee, 0-5)

ids.title: Rigors / shaking chills

ids.title: Abdominal distension on inspection/percussion

ids.title: Costovertebral angle (flank) tenderness

ids.title: Saddle (perineal) sensory loss and reduced anal tone

ids.title: Dysuria and urinary frequency/urgency (new)

ids.title: Right lower quadrant pain with periumbilical-to-RLQ migration
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1996 'Does this patient have appendicitis?' Wagner JM, McKinney WP, Carpenter JL; PMID 8918857

ids.title: POCUS gallbladder: stones, wall thickening, sonographic Murphy sign
ids.anchor_source: Ross M et al 2011 'Emergency physician-performed ultrasound to diagnose cholelithiasis: a systematic review' Acad Emerg Med; PMID 21401784; index: JAMA RCE 2003 Trowbridge RL PMID 12503981

ids.title: Hot swollen joint with effusion and painful/limited range of motion (refusal to bear weight)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2007 'Does this adult patient have septic arthritis?' Margaretten ME, Kohlwes J, Moore D, Bent S; PMID 17405973

ids.title: Ice-pack test (ptosis improves >=2 mm after 2 min ice)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2005 'Does this patient have myasthenia gravis?' Scherer K, Bedlack RS, Simel DL; PMID 15840866 (ice test LR+ ~24)

ids.title: New or progressive back pain in a patient with known cancer (or age >50, night pain, weight loss)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1992 'What can the history and physical examination tell us about low back pain?' Deyo RA, Rainville J, Kent DL; PMID 1386391; Cochrane 2013 'Red flags to screen for malignancy in patients with low-back pain' Henschke N et al PMID 23450586; Deyo RA, Diehl AK 1988 J Gen Intern Med PMID 2967893

ids.title: Work of breathing: accessory muscle use, tripoding, pursed-lip breathing, inability to speak full sentences
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1995 'Does the clinical examination predict airflow limitation?' Holleman DR, Simel DL; PMID 7815660 (accessory muscle use / sternomastoid contraction reported); severity anchor: Global Initiative for Asthma (GINA) report, 2024 update — severity assessment table (guideline; no PMID)

ids.title: Anaphylaxis signs: urticaria/flushing, angioedema, stridor, wheeze (NIAID/FAAN criteria)
ids.anchor_source: Sampson HA et al 2006 NIAID/FAAN criteria, J Allergy Clin Immunol PMID 16461139; validation: Campbell RL et al, J Allergy Clin Immunol 2012 PMID 22051698

ids.title: Asterixis (flapping tremor with wrists extended)
ids.anchor_source: Formentin C et al, Dig Liver Dis 2020 'Clinical value of asterixis in 374 well-characterised patients with cirrhosis and varying degree of hepatic encephalopathy' PMID 31582327; AASLD/EASL HE guideline 2014 Vilstrup H et al PMID 25042402

ids.title: Chest percussion hyperresonance (diffuse with barrel chest = COPD; unilateral = pneumothorax)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1995 'Does the clinical examination predict airflow limitation?' Holleman DR, Simel DL; PMID 7815660

ids.title: Conjunctival rim pallor (and palmar crease / nail-bed pallor)
ids.anchor_source: J Gen Intern Med 1997 'The relation of conjunctival pallor to the presence of anemia' Sheth TN et al; PMID 9051559 ; also Arch Intern Med 1990 'Usefulness of physical examination in detecting the presence or absence of anemia' Nardone DA et al; PMID 2297289

ids.title: Cool vs warm extremities (cold/wet vs warm profile)
ids.anchor_source: Nohria A et al, J Am Coll Cardiol 2003 'Clinical assessment identifies hemodynamic profiles that predict outcomes in patients admitted with heart failure'; PMID 12767667

ids.title: New diastolic (aortic regurgitation) murmur
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2002 'Does this patient have an acute thoracic aortic dissection?' Klompas M; PMID 11980527 ; also Acad Emerg Med 2018 'Clinical examination for acute aortic dissection: a systematic review and meta-analysis' Ohle R et al; PMID 29265487

ids.title: Systolic BP <90 mmHg (or MAP <65) at the bedside
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2007 'Does this patient with a pericardial effusion have cardiac tamponade?' Roy CL et al; PMID 17456823 ; HF context: JAMA RCE 2005 'Does this dyspneic patient in the emergency department have congestive heart failure?' Wang CS et al; PMID 16234501

ids.title: Muffled/diminished heart sounds (Beck triad component)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2007 'Does this patient with a pericardial effusion have cardiac tamponade?' Roy CL et al; PMID 17456823

ids.title: New or changed regurgitant murmur
ids.anchor_source: 'Role of the New Physical Examination Minor Criterion (New Heart Murmur) for the Diagnosis of Infective Endocarditis' Open Forum Infect Dis 2025; PMID 39790639; peripheral stigmata frequency: JAMA Dermatol 2014 PMID 24500311

ids.title: Left parasternal (RV) heave and loud/palpable P2
ids.anchor_source: PLoS One 2014 'Utility of the physical examination in detecting pulmonary hypertension. A mixed methods study' Colman R et al; PMID 25343585

ids.title: Pericardial friction rub (triphasic scratchy sound, LSB, leaning forward, end-expiration)
ids.anchor_source: Eur Heart J 2015 '2015 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of pericardial diseases' Adler Y et al; PMID 26320112 (diagnostic criteria: rub is 1 of 4)

ids.title: Pupils and eye movements: miosis with hypoventilation (opioid), ophthalmoplegia/nystagmus with ataxia (Wernicke), gaze deviation
ids.anchor_source: Caine D et al, J Neurol Neurosurg Psychiatry 1997 'Operational criteria for the classification of chronic alcoholics: identification of Wernicke's encephalopathy' PMID 9010400; EFNS Wernicke guideline Galvin R et al 2010 PMID 20642790

ids.title: Spider angiomata (>=3, upper trunk/face/arms), with palmar erythema and gynecomastia as companions
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2012 'Does this patient with liver disease have cirrhosis?' Udell JA et al; PMID 22357834

ids.title: Inspiratory stridor at rest (audible without stethoscope)
ids.anchor_source: No RCE; anaphylaxis/airway consensus (World Allergy Organization Anaphylaxis Guidance 2020, Cardona V et al, World Allergy Organ J; PMID 33204386 — unconfirmed)

ids.title: Resting heart rate >100/min (and postural pulse increment)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1999 'Is this patient hypovolemic?' McGee S, Abernethy WB, Simel DL; PMID 10086438 ; PE context: JAMA RCE 2003 'Does this patient have pulmonary embolism?' Chunilal SD et al; PMID 14657070 ; tamponade: JAMA RCE 2007 'Does this patient with a pericardial effusion have cardiac tamponade?' Roy CL et al; PMID 17456823

ids.title: Signs of thyrotoxicosis: fine tremor, lid lag/retraction, warm moist skin, goiter, hyperreflexia
ids.anchor_source: Thyroid 2016 '2016 American Thyroid Association Guidelines for Diagnosis and Management of Hyperthyroidism' Ross DS et al; PMID 27521067 ; no RCE for hyperthyroidism signs

ids.title: Bedside walk / ambulatory desaturation and dyspnea reproduction test (hallway walk with pulse-ox, ability to complete)
ids.anchor_source: No RCE or diagnostic-accuracy meta-analysis for inpatient hallway walk; ATS/ERS 6-minute walk technical standard (Holland AE et al, Eur Respir J 2014; PMID 25359355 — unconfirmed) as procedural anchor

ids.title: Forced expiratory time >6-9 s (stethoscope over trachea, full forced exhalation)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1995 'Does the clinical examination predict airflow limitation?' Holleman DR, Simel DL; PMID 7815660

ids.title: Panic/anxiety features: episodes at rest or with stress, dread, paresthesias, known panic disorder; not affected by sleep
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2009 'Does this patient with palpitations have a cardiac arrhythmia?' Thavendiranathan P et al; PMID 19920238 (history of panic disorder, 'affected by sleeping', palpitations at work)

ids.title: Smoking history: >40 (or >=70) pack-years, current smoker
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2000 'The accuracy of patient history, wheezing, and laryngeal measurements in diagnosing obstructive airway disease' (CARE-COAD1) Straus SE et al; PMID 10770147

ids.title: POCUS lung: subpleural consolidation with air bronchograms / hepatization (+/- focal B-lines) for pneumonia
ids.anchor_source: Respir Res 2014 'Lung ultrasound for the diagnosis of pneumonia in adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis' Chavez MA et al; PMID 24758612

ids.title: POCUS: anechoic dependent pleural collection with spine sign / lung flapping
ids.anchor_source: Emerg (Tehran) 2016 'Screening performance characteristic of ultrasonography and radiography in detection of pleural effusion; a meta-analysis' Yousefifard M et al; PMID 26862542

ids.title: Focal neurologic deficit (limb weakness, aphasia, Horner) accompanying chest/back pain
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2002 'Does this patient have an acute thoracic aortic dissection?' Klompas M; PMID 11980527 ; also Acad Emerg Med 2018 'Clinical examination for acute aortic dissection: a systematic review and meta-analysis' Ohle R et al; PMID 29265487

ids.title: Family history of sudden cardiac death <50 y or inherited cardiomyopathy/channelopathy
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2019 'Did this patient have cardiac syncope?' Albassam OT et al; PMID 31237649 ; guideline: Eur Heart J 2018 '2018 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of syncope' Brignole M et al; PMID 29562304

ids.title: Pain that is positional (changes with posture; relieved leaning forward = pericarditis; ACS negative)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA 2005 'Value and limitations of chest pain history in the evaluation of patients with suspected acute coronary syndromes' Swap CJ, Nagurney JT; PMID 16304077 ; pericarditis relief leaning forward: Eur Heart J 2015 '2015 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of pericardial diseases' Adler Y et al; PMID 26320112

ids.title: Shock index (HR / SBP >= 0.9-1.0)
ids.anchor_source: Koch E et al, Open Access Emerg Med 2019 'Shock index in the emergency department: utility and limitations' (review); PMID 31616192. Extractor should trace to primary cohorts cited therein.

ids.title: Carotid sinus massage 5-10 s each side, supine then upright, with continuous BP/pulse; contraindicated with bruit, TIA/stroke or MI within 3 months
ids.anchor_source: Arch Intern Med 2006 'Carotid sinus hypersensitivity in asymptomatic older persons: implications for diagnosis of syncope and falls' Kerr SR et al; PMID 16534037 ; procedure/criteria: Eur Heart J 2018 '2018 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of syncope' Brignole M et al; PMID 29562304

ids.title: Hypoglycemia history: insulin/sulfonylurea use, missed meals, adrenergic or neuroglycopenic symptoms
ids.anchor_source: Cryer PE et al, J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2009 Endocrine Society hypoglycemic disorders guideline PMID 19088155 || Hepburn DA et al 1991 'Symptoms of acute insulin-induced hypoglycemia in humans with and without IDDM. Factor-analysis approach' Diabetes Care; PMID 1797507 (symptom clusters, not diagnostic accuracy)

ids.title: Antihypertensive / sedative / new-medication review (timing of last doses)
Response of ongoing palpitations to Valsalva/modified Valsalva or carotid massage: abrupt termination vs transient slowing vs none
ids.anchor_source: No diagnostic-accuracy study; ESC 2019 SVT Guideline (Brugada J et al, Eur Heart J 2020; PMID 31504425 — unconfirmed) and REVERT trial (Appelboam A, Lancet 2015) address termination, not diagnosis

ids.title: Stemmer sign: inability to pinch a skin fold at the base of the 2nd toe
ids.anchor_source: Plast Reconstr Surg Glob Open 2019 'Sensitivity and specificity of the Stemmer sign for lymphedema: a clinical lymphoscintigraphic study' Goss JA, Greene AK; PMID 31624689

ids.title: Medication review for edema: dihydropyridine CCB, NSAIDs, thiazolidinediones, pregabalin/gabapentin, steroids, minoxidil/hydralazine
ids.anchor_source: No RCE; drug-induced edema narrative/consensus reviews only; anchor to product labelling and AHA HF guideline 2022 (Heidenreich PA et al, Circulation 2022; PMID 35363499 — unconfirmed) for TZD/NSAID cautions

ids.title: Focused infection-source exam (line/exit sites, skin, abdomen, joints, sacrum, urine catheter)
ids.anchor_source: Mermel LA et al, Clin Infect Dis 2009 IDSA catheter-related infection guideline PMID 19489710 (line site signs are insensitive); Seymour CW et al, JAMA 2016 qSOFA PMID 26903335 for context

ids.title: Central line exit-site erythema, tenderness, or purulence (with line-day count)
ids.anchor_source: Safdar N, Maki DG 2002 'Inflammation at the insertion site is not predictive of catheter-related bloodstream infection with short-term, noncuffed central venous catheters' Crit Care Med; PMID 12483050

ids.title: Skin turgor decreased (slow recoil of pinched skin, subclavicular or forearm)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 1999 'Is this patient hypovolemic?' McGee S, Abernethy WB, Simel DL; PMID 10086438

ids.title: Glucocorticoid exposure / abrupt withdrawal, known adrenal disease, hyperpigmentation
ids.anchor_source: Bornstein SR et al, J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2016 Endocrine Society primary adrenal insufficiency guideline; PMID 26760044

ids.title: POCUS free intraperitoneal fluid (FAST views)
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2012 'Does this adult patient have a blunt intra-abdominal injury?' Nishijima DK, Simel DL, Wisner DH, Holmes JF; PMID 22496266 (FAST LRs; trauma population only)

ids.title: Suprapubic palpation / percussion for distended bladder; LUTS and prostate history
Tense, distended abdomen (suspected intra-abdominal hypertension)
ids.anchor_source: Kirkpatrick AW et al, Can J Surg 2000 'Is clinical examination an accurate indicator of raised intra-abdominal pressure in critically injured patients?' PMID 10851415; WSACS 2013 consensus Intensive Care Med PMID 23673399

ids.title: Muscle pain/weakness, prolonged immobilization or exertion, dark cola-colored urine
ids.anchor_source: Bosch X et al, N Engl J Med 2009 'Rhabdomyolysis and acute kidney injury' PMID 19571284

ids.title: Test of skew (alternate cover test; vertical ocular misalignment)
ids.anchor_source: Kattah JC et al, Stroke 2009 'HINTS to diagnose stroke in the acute vestibular syndrome'; PMID 19762709; Tarnutzer AA et al, CMAJ 2011 'Does my dizzy patient have a stroke? A systematic review of bedside diagnosis in acute vestibular syndrome'; PMID 21576300

ids.title: Charcot triad at the bedside (fever + RUQ pain/tenderness + jaundice)
ids.anchor_source: Tokyo Guidelines 2018 'Diagnostic criteria and severity grading of acute cholangitis' Kiriyama S et al, J Hepatobiliary Pancreat Sci 2018; PMID 29032610 (reports Charcot triad sensitivity/specificity vs TG criteria)

ids.title: Subtle twitching (face/limbs), eye deviation, nystagmoid jerks, fluctuating responsiveness (NCSE screen)
ids.anchor_source: Husain AM et al, J Neurol Neurosurg Psychiatry 2003 'Non-convulsive status epilepticus: usefulness of clinical features in selecting patients for urgent EEG' PMID 12531946

ids.title: Attention test: months of the year backward / digit span
ids.anchor_source: JAMA RCE 2010 'Does this patient have delirium? Value of bedside instruments' Wong CL et al; PMID 20716741; O'Regan NA et al, Int J Geriatr Psychiatry 2017 'Five short screening tests in the detection of prevalent delirium' PMID 27917538; 4AT meta-analysis Tieges Z et al, Age Ageing 2021 PMID 33951145

ids.title: Localized LLQ tenderness (with prior diverticulitis episode history)
ids.anchor_source: Lameris W et al 2010 'A clinical decision rule to establish the diagnosis of acute diverticulitis at the emergency department' Dis Colon Rectum; PMID 20485003

ids.title: Pain out of proportion to examination findings
ids.anchor_source: Cudnik MT et al 2013 'The diagnosis of acute mesenteric ischemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis' Acad Emerg Med; PMID 24238311 (clinical features largely not pooled; use for AF/vascular-risk context)

ids.title: Antibiotic exposure within 8-12 weeks plus new watery diarrhea (>=3/day) or ileus/distension
ids.anchor_source: Garey KW et al 2008 'A clinical risk index for Clostridium difficile infection in hospitalised patients receiving broad-spectrum antibiotics' J Hosp Infect; PMID 18723249; IDSA/SHEA 2017 CDI guideline for case definition

ids.title: Forehead sparing (central) vs forehead involvement (peripheral) in facial weakness
ids.anchor_source: AAN evidence-based guideline / AAO-HNS Bell's palsy clinical practice guideline 2013 (consensus); no diagnostic-accuracy pooled data identified

ids.title: Proximal symmetric weakness (chair-rise/Gowers-type maneuver, arm abduction) without focal deficit
ids.anchor_source: Hermans G et al 2012 'Interobserver agreement of Medical Research Council sum-score and handgrip strength in the intensive care unit' Muscle Nerve; PMID 22190301 (MRC grading reliability; ICU-acquired weakness)

ids.title: Kussmaul sign: JVP rises (or fails to fall) with inspiration
ids.anchor_source: Eur Heart J 2015 '2015 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of pericardial diseases' Adler Y et al; PMID 26320112 (constrictive pericarditis section); no diagnostic-accuracy study

ids.title: Unilateral dermatomal vesicular rash (or dermatomal allodynia preceding rash)
ids.anchor_source: No RCE; clinical diagnosis per IDSA/CDC zoster guidance; case-based literature only

ids.title: Constant epigastric pain radiating to the back (with alcohol/gallstone history)
ids.anchor_source: Dickson AP, Imrie CW 1984 'The incidence and prognosis of body wall ecchymosis in acute pancreatitis' Surg Gynecol Obstet; PMID 6237447 (Cullen/Grey Turner frequency only); pain character itself guideline/consensus

ids.title: Rash, fever, arthralgia after new drug (AIN triad)
ids.anchor_source: Perazella MA, Markowitz GS, Nat Rev Nephrol 2010 'Drug-induced acute interstitial nephritis' PMID 20517290 (classic triad present in ~10%)

ids.title: Fever onset temporally linked to a new drug (with rash/relative bradycardia)
ids.anchor_source: Mackowiak PA, LeMaistre CF 1987 'Drug fever: a critical appraisal of conventional concepts. An analysis of 51 episodes in two Dallas hospitals and 97 episodes reported in the English literature' Ann Intern Med; PMID 3565971; relative bradycardia: Cunha BA 2000 Clin Microbiol Infect PMID 11284920
